name: pyrox
description: Write probabilistic models in JAX with Equinox and NumPyro on pyrox — modules that own their sample / param sites, kernels with priors and guides, exact / sparse / Markov / multi-output GPs, Bayesian layers, ensemble MAP / VI, latent Gaussian models with INLA — instead of hand-wiring numpyro.sample into Equinox modules.
